text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Trainer!
What's with that sleepy look on yer face?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, ya gotta get up early and do radio calisthenics!
It wakes ya right up like magic!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Fold both ears back
and do the floppy-wiggle workout~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up joining in on
Tamamo Cross's unique radio calisthenics.
